svg.title: Public and internal destinations stay distinct
svg.desc: Place internal and public destinations on opposite sides of the service with explicit scope boundaries. A new header and date prevent an outward path from silently becoming the same inward event. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
